root_cause.text: The function `cifs_set_cifscreds()` in `fs/smb/client/connect.c` logs the entire key payload (containing plaintext username and password) to debug output via `cifs_dbg(FYI, "payload=%s\n", payload);`, exposing credentials when debug logging is enabled.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the debug log line `cifs_dbg(FYI, "payload=%s\n", payload);` from `cifs_set_cifscreds()`; the commit message explicitly states that this log exposes the plaintext username and password.
